test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

Orders are being processed by the system.

options.text: The system has been processing orders.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: In the passive voice, the focus is on the object receiving the action. The original sentence "Orders are being processed by the system" is in the **Present Continuous Passive**.
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the agent ("the system") and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
• Maintain the tense: The passive form "are being processed" must be converted to the active **Present Continuous** form, which is "is processing."
 
• The original subject "Orders" becomes the direct object in the active sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The system is processing orders."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The system processes the orders." – This uses the Simple Present tense instead of Present Continuous.
 
• **Option 2: **"The system has been processing orders." – This uses the Present Perfect Continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"The system processed orders." – This uses the Simple Past tense.
